benefits.title: Why bet on UGC content
benefits.description: Many people trust someone who uses a product or service in everyday life more than a highly produced ad. UGC (user-generated content) shows your brand in real situations, with a close-up camera and a natural tone. It works for your social media, your website and as a paid ad, and gives you varied material to test which message works best with your audience.

hero.title: SEO & International SEO Services
paragraphs: Showing up on Google isn't a matter of luck, it's a matter of strategy. My SEO service turns your website into a channel that attracts people already searching for what you offer: not just more visits, but visits with real interest.

I analyze your site's starting point and design a plan tailored to you: I improve the technical structure, the relevance of your content and your domain's authority. I explain every step and we work with clear priorities.

items.title: Professional SEO Audit
items.description: I start with a free 30-minute mini audit: I review your website, your Google Business Profile and whether you show up when someone asks ChatGPT or Gemini about your sector, and I show you the 3 most important problems. If you need to go deeper, the full audit covers the whole site and ends with a prioritized plan.
items.headline: Find out what's wrong and what to fix first
points: Technical SEO: crawling, indexing and mobile speed
Structure, internal linking and on-page content
A prioritized plan and 1 hour to walk you through it
Ideal before a redesign or if someone can apply the changes

items.title: SEO Consulting & Digital Strategy
items.description: An audit tells you what's wrong; consulting tells you what to do and in what order. The groundwork is the same in all three options: what changes is how much I support you and who applies the changes. After the first 3 months you can continue with a monthly plan.
items.kicker: A plan and someone beside you
items.headline: Choose how much support you want
points: Plan: I give you the action plan and you apply it
Plan + support: one consultation a month for 3 months and I review what you apply
Plan + implementation: I apply the changes and explain them every month
One-off consultation for a specific question: a redesign, a domain change, a blog

items.title: Local SEO in Elche and the Costa Blanca
items.description: If your business serves customers in a specific area, showing up on the map and in local searches matters as much as having a good website. I mainly work with businesses in Elche, Alicante and the Costa Blanca that welcome international customers, so tourists and residents searching in other languages can find you too.
items.headline: Get found on the map, in English and French too
points: Optimized Google Business Profile, also in other languages

Service and area pages, with consistent details on your site and directories
Tracking calls, clicks and visits from day one

international.title: International & Multilingual SEO Specialist
international.description: Taking a website international isn't about installing a machine-translation plugin. Every market searches differently, so I start by researching which terms users in each country actually use and with what intent. From there I adapt the content and set up what's needed on the technical side, such as hreflang tags, so Google shows each version to the right audience. If you also need a website translation service, we handle it within the same strategy so language and ranking don't go separate ways.

items: Up-to-date training. Private course in digital marketing and SEO, plus ongoing training in international SEO and search-focused content.
